items.criterion: grep -c os.access tests/test_spec_alignment_check.py >= 1; GITREINS_REPO=/nonexistent python3 -m pytest tests/test_spec_alignment_check.py -q => 0 failed 0 errors with the leg skipped and reasoned; readable GITREINS_REPO runs the leg; unreadable-but-present also skips
items.detail: grep -c os.access tests/test_spec_alignment_check.py => 5 (lines 86, 714, 786, 800, plus docstring line 28). `GITREINS_REPO=/nonexistent python3 -m pytest tests/test_spec_alignment_check.py -q -rs` => exit 0, "28 passed, 1 skipped in 7.09s" with "SKIPPED [1] tests/test_spec_alignment_check.py:640: cross-repo proof: no GitReins checkout at /nonexistent (set GITREINS_REPO); /nonexistent/engine/spec_alignment.py is ABSENT, so the real-argv leg runs only on a host that has both repositories" — 0 failed, 0 errors, leg skipped AND reasoned. Readable checkout: default run `python3 -m pytest tests/test_spec_alignment_check.py -v` => "29 passed in 9.13s", test_gitreins_real_invocation_against_the_real_auger_binary PASSED [72%] (leg actually runs against /home/kara/gitreins). Unreadable-but-present: test_the_cross_repo_guard_treats_an_unreadable_checkout_as_absent PASSED, test_the_cross_repo_leg_skips_on_an_unreadable_checkout PASSED, test_a_real_chmod_to_zero_is_reported_as_unreadable PASSED (uid 1000, not root, so the chmod arm is live). Independent probe of the guard: readable -> '', mode-000 module -> '... is present but .../engine/spec_alignment.py is UNREADABLE by uid 1000; the real-argv leg skips instead of raising PermissionError on import', absent -> '... is ABSENT ...'. `python3 -m ruff check tests/test_spec_alignment_check.py` => "All checks passed!".

items.criterion: The readability guard is wired into the real-argv leg itself (not just a helper): test_gitreins_real_invocation_against_the_real_auger_binary calls gitreins_cross_repo_skip_reason(GITREINS) and pytest.skip()s before `from engine import spec_alignment`, so an unreadable checkout can no longer raise PermissionError at import.
items.detail: tests/test_spec_alignment_check.py:638-640 — `skip_reason = gitreins_cross_repo_skip_reason(GITREINS); if skip_reason: pytest.skip(skip_reason)` executes before `from engine import spec_alignment` at line 643, closing the PermissionError-at-import path the commit message describes. test_the_cross_repo_leg_skips_on_an_unreadable_checkout drives the real leg function and asserts pytest.skip.Exception carrying the path and "UNREADABLE" — PASSED in the `-k "cross_repo or chmod or readability"` run (6 passed, 23 deselected).

items.criterion: A guard that always skips (silently disabling the cross-repo proof) must be caught: a readable checkout must yield an empty reason and the real leg must actually run.
items.detail: tests/test_spec_alignment_check.py:757-766 test_the_cross_repo_guard_lets_a_readable_checkout_run asserts gitreins_cross_repo_skip_reason(fake_checkout) == "" — PASSED. The real leg is not silently disabled: default run `python3 -m pytest tests/test_spec_alignment_check.py -v` shows test_gitreins_real_invocation_against_the_real_auger_binary PASSED [72%] with 29 passed and no skip. Manual probe: readable -> ''.

items.criterion: The absent and unreadable causes must stay distinguishable in the skip reason, and the probe must be a read check (os.R_OK) rather than a bare existence test.
items.detail: tests/test_spec_alignment_check.py:88-108 — the absent branch returns a reason containing "ABSENT", the unreadable branch one containing "UNREADABLE by uid <euid>". test_the_cross_repo_guard_reports_an_absent_checkout_as_absent asserts "ABSENT" in reason and "UNREADABLE" not in reason (PASSED); test_the_cross_repo_guard_treats_an_unreadable_checkout_as_absent asserts "UNREADABLE" and "PermissionError" (PASSED); test_the_readability_probe_asks_os_access_for_r_ok pins seen == [(target, os.R_OK)] (PASSED). Manual probe produced three distinct results: readable -> '', mode000 -> '... UNREADABLE by uid 1000 ...', absent -> '... is ABSENT ...'.
